```{r}

sample_sizes <- sapply(effect_sizes, function(delta) {
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
# Compute power for each sample size
power_values <- sapply(sample_sizes, function(n) {
  result <- power.t.test(n = n, delta = effect_size_10, sd = sd_value, sig.level = alpha, type = "two.sample", alternative = "one.sided")
  return(result$power)
})
```

```{r}

```

```{r}

       x = "Sample Size", 
       y = "Power") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") + # Reference line at 80% power
  annotate("text", x = 50, y = 0.82, label = "80% Power Threshold", color = "black", size = 5)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Load data
data <- read.csv("D:/Second Semester/Project Multivariate and Hierarchical Data/G10.pilot.data.csv")

# Compute standard deviation of quality_index
sd_value <- sd(data$quality_index, na.rm = TRUE)

# Define parameters
alpha <- 0.05
sample_sizes <- seq(10, 250, by = 5)
effect_sizes <- c(10, 15, 20, 25)

# Compute power
power_df <- expand.grid(Sample_Size = sample_sizes, Effect_Size = effect_sizes)
power_df$Power <- mapply(function(n, es) {
  result <- power.t.test(n = n, delta = es, sd = sd_value, sig.level = alpha, type = "two.sample", alternative = "one.sided")
  return(result$power)
}, power_df$Sample_Size, power_df$Effect_Size)

# Convert Effect_Size to factor
power_df$Effect_Size <- as.factor(power_df$Effect_Size)

# Create a data frame for horizontal lines with power thresholds
power_lines <- data.frame(
  Power = c(0.80, 0.85, 0.90),
  Label = as.factor(c("Power = 0.80", "Power = 0.85", "Power = 0.90"))
)

# Plot
ggplot(power_df, aes(x = Sample_Size, y = Power, color = Effect_Size)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(data = power_lines, aes(yintercept = Power, linetype = Label), color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Power vs Sample Size for Different Effect Sizes",
    x = "Sample Size",
    y = "Power",
    color = "Effect Size",
    linetype = "Power Threshold"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)  # Center title
  )

```

```{r}
# Load necessary library
library(ggplot2)

# Compute standard deviation of quality_index from your pilot data
data <- read.csv("D:/Second Semester/Project Multivariate and Hierarchical Data/G10.pilot.data.csv")
sd_value <- sd(data$quality_index, na.rm = TRUE)

# Parameters
alpha <- 0.05
power_values <- seq(0.80, 0.90, by = 0.05)   # Power from 0.80 to 0.90
effect_sizes <- seq(10, 25, by = 5)          # Effect size from 10 to 25

# Calculate required sample sizes
sample_size_df <- expand.grid(Power = power_values, Effect_Size = effect_sizes)
sample_size_df$Sample_Size <- mapply(function(pwr, eff) {
  res <- power.t.test(delta = eff, sd = sd_value, sig.level = alpha, power = pwr, type = "two.sample", alternative = "one.sided")
  return(res$n)
}, sample_size_df$Power, sample_size_df$Effect_Size)

sample_size_df

```

```{r}
ggplot(sample_size_df, aes(x = Effect_Size, y = Sample_Size, color = as.factor(Power))) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Required Sample Size vs. Effect Size for Different Power Levels",
    x = "Effect Size",
    y = "Required Sample Size (per group)",
    color = "Power"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
